note: Common prayers shown under Hours > Prayers. Each block has a kind (heading, prayer or note). In a prayer, put matching Latin and English on matching lines; an English-only prayer leaves latin out.

blocks.latin:
℣. Ángelus Dómini nuntiávit Maríæ.
℟. Et concépit de Spíritu Sancto.
blocks.english:
℣. The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary.
℟. And she conceived of the Holy Spirit.

blocks.latin:
Ave María, grátia plena,
Dóminus tecum;
benedícta tu in muliéribus,
et benedíctus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
Sancta María, Mater Dei,
ora pro nobis peccatóribus,
nunc et in hora mortis nostræ. Amen.
blocks.english:
Hail Mary, full of grace,
the Lord is with thee;
blessed art thou among women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

blocks.latin:
℣. Ecce ancílla Dómini.
℟. Fiat mihi secúndum verbum tuum.
blocks.english:
℣. Behold the handmaid of the Lord.
℟. Be it done unto me according to thy word.
Hail Mary

blocks.latin:
℣. Et Verbum caro factum est.
℟. Et habitávit in nobis.
blocks.english:
℣. And the Word was made flesh.
℟. And dwelt among us.
Hail Mary

blocks.latin:
℣. Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
℟. Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.
blocks.english:
℣. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.
Let us pray.

blocks.latin:
Grátiam tuam, quǽsumus, Dómine,
méntibus nostris infúnde:
ut qui, Ángelo nuntiánte,
Christi Fílii tui incarnatiónem cognóvimus,
per passiónem eius et crucem
ad resurrectiónis glóriam perducámur.
Per eúndem Christum Dóminum nostrum. Amen.
blocks.english:
Pour forth, we beseech thee, O Lord,
thy grace into our hearts:
that we, to whom, by the message of an Angel,
the incarnation of Christ thy Son was made known,
may by his passion and cross
be brought to the glory of his resurrection.
Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.
Sign of the Cross

blocks.latin:
In nómine Patris, et Fílii,
et Spíritus Sancti. Amen.
blocks.english:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son,
and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
Apostles’ Creed

blocks.latin:
Credo in Deum, Patrem omnipoténtem,
Creatórem cæli et terræ.
Et in Iesum Christum,
Fílium eius únicum, Dóminum nostrum:
qui concéptus est de Spíritu Sancto,
natus ex María Vírgine,
passus sub Póntio Piláto,
crucifíxus, mórtuus, et sepúltus:
descéndit ad ínferos:
tértia die resurréxit a mórtuis:
ascéndit ad cælos:
sedet ad déxteram Dei Patris omnipoténtis:
inde ventúrus est iudicáre vivos et mórtuos.
Credo in Spíritum Sanctum,
sanctam Ecclésiam cathólicam,
Sanctórum communiónem,
remissiónem peccatórum,
carnis resurrectiónem,
vitam ætérnam. Amen.
blocks.english:
I believe in God, the Father almighty,
Creator of heaven and earth.
And in Jesus Christ,
his only Son, our Lord:
who was conceived by the Holy Spirit,
born of the Virgin Mary,
suffered under Pontius Pilate,
was crucified, died, and was buried:
he descended into hell:
the third day he rose again from the dead:
he ascended into heaven:
and sits at the right hand of God the Father almighty:
from thence he shall come to judge the living and the dead.
I believe in the Holy Spirit,
the holy catholic Church,
the communion of Saints,
the forgiveness of sins,
the resurrection of the body,
and life everlasting. Amen.
Our Father

blocks.latin:
Pater noster, qui es in cælis,
sanctificétur nomen tuum:
advéniat regnum tuum:
fiat volúntas tua,
sicut in cælo et in terra.
Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie:
et dimítte nobis débita nostra,
sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris:
et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
blocks.english:
Our Father, who art in heaven,
hallowed be thy name:
thy kingdom come:
thy will be done
on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread:
and forgive us our trespasses,
as we forgive those who trespass against us:
and lead us not into temptation:
but deliver us from evil. Amen.
Hail Mary

blocks.latin:
Ave María, grátia plena,
Dóminus tecum;
benedícta tu in muliéribus,
et benedíctus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
Sancta María, Mater Dei,
ora pro nobis peccatóribus,
nunc et in hora mortis nostræ. Amen.
blocks.english:
Hail Mary, full of grace,
the Lord is with thee;
blessed art thou among women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
Glory Be

blocks.latin:
Glória Patri, et Fílio,
et Spirítui Sancto.
Sicut erat in princípio,
et nunc, et semper,
et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.english:
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end. Amen.
Fatima Prayer

blocks.latin:
Dómine Iesu, dimítte nobis débita nostra,
salva nos ab igne inferióri,
perduc in cælum omnes ánimas,
præsértim eas, quæ misericórdiæ tuæ máxime índigent.
blocks.english:
O my Jesus, forgive us our sins,
save us from the fires of hell,
lead all souls to heaven,
especially those in most need of thy mercy.
Hail, Holy Queen

blocks.latin:
Salve, Regína, Mater misericórdiæ,
vita, dulcédo, et spes nostra, salve.
Ad te clamámus, éxsules fílii Hevæ.
Ad te suspirámus, geméntes et flentes
in hac lacrimárum valle.
Eia ergo, advocáta nostra,
illos tuos misericórdes óculos ad nos convérte.
Et Iesum, benedíctum fructum ventris tui,
nobis post hoc exsílium osténde.
O clemens, O pia, O dulcis Virgo María.
blocks.english:
Hail, holy Queen, Mother of mercy,
our life, our sweetness, and our hope, hail.
To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve.
To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping
in this valley of tears.
Turn then, most gracious advocate,
thine eyes of mercy toward us.
And Jesus, the blessed fruit of thy womb,
show unto us after this our exile.
O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

blocks.latin:
℣. Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
℟. Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.
blocks.english:
℣. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

O most holy Heart of Jesus,
fountain of every blessing,
I adore thee, I love thee,
and with lively sorrow for my sins
I offer thee this poor heart of mine.

Make me humble, patient, pure
and wholly obedient to thy will.
Grant, good Jesus,
that I may live in thee and for thee.

Protect me in the midst of danger.
Comfort me in my afflictions.
Give me health of body,
assistance in my temporal needs,
thy blessing on all that I do,
and the grace of a holy death. Amen.

Most Sacred Heart of Jesus,
have mercy on us.
